correctness.rationale: For every \(p\in(0,1)\), the exact geometric stopping law induces \(K=\lfloor L/2\rfloor\) with tail \((1-p)^{2j}\), and the Green diagonal is its mean plus one. The Fréchet lower bounds for all product-tail events are attained by the same countermonotone inverse-CDF law; hence the finite \(J(t)\) formula is globally exact. A direct per-time joint survival computation proves the stagewise \(r^{2\min(j,k)}t^{|j-k|}\) sum; testing the \(j=k=1\) event proves strictness for all \(p<1/2\). \(J=0\) exactly for \(2t\le1\). Dominated convergence of scaled geometric quantiles yields the limit \(2-\pi^2/6\), independently of finite experiments. The rational \(p=1/3\) instance and supplemental 1,296 tests match.

originality.rationale: The new object is the exact variance of a one-walk unsquared two-node Green diagonal averaged over two geometrically stopped paths, optimized over the entire space of pair couplings; its explicit stagewise comparison, two phase thresholds, rational example and long-walk constant are not present in the closely inspected full-source statements. The graph-walk framework, stagewise antithetic mechanism, general OT approach, classical countermonotone theorem and exponential antithetic integral are all prior art and not claimed new. Search cannot prove absolute novelty.
residual_risks: A historical specialist work may have independently tabulated the same countermonotone geometric counts under renewal-process or antithetic-variates terminology.

The all-coupling optimum alone is a standard Fréchet consequence; originality rests on the complete graph-Green variance-vs-stagewise classification and its sharp asymptotic rather than on inventing countermonotonicity.
The result applies to the one-walk unsquared resolvent and cannot be silently generalized to bilinear graph kernels.

value.rationale: The canonical smallest nontrivial graph isolates global-versus-stepwise stopping dependence while preserving exact marginal walk laws. The two distinct sharp phase thresholds and persistent about 64.5 percent long-walk variance reduction provide a meaningful exact control baseline for cost-equivalent randomized resolvent estimation. The full parameter range and sharp asymptotic contrast are not arbitrary finite computations or a claim of a general optimal-transport invention.
